About

Honest Roofing. Reliable Services.
Honest Abe Roofing has been installing, repairing, and maintaining residential roofs since 2007. It is our goal to bring a customer service focus to the roofing industry. We are aware that we are providing a very important and necessary service to many homes, so we work incredibly hard to provide the best possible roofing at the most competitive pricing. All of our customers are very important to us, and we want to give them a perfect roof to protect their home and keep them comfortable. Each of our professionals is fully certified and has passed extensive background checks and drug tests, so you can rest easy knowing you have a completely reliable team of experts working on your home.

Honest Abe Roofing Offers Easy Payment Solutions
With Honest Abe Roofing, roofing services are always pain-free and easy. You can choose from various financing plans including same-as-cash, 0% financing, long-term/low-payment, and even options for those with subprime credit.

Licensed Roofing Contractors
Hiring a non-licensed contractor is simply not worth the risk. Financially, you may end up facing litigation if something goes wrong and the contractor is not insured. Most states require their licensed roofing contractors to receive an official examination, years of education, background checks, and carry some kind of insurance. A licensed contractor will also know local codes and requirements so that your home is both safe and compliant with local laws. With Honest Abe Roofing, you can rest assured your roofers are appropriately licensed according to state laws.

Certified Roofers Who Know Their Products
Sometimes, certification and licensing are used interchangeably. But technically, a roofing license is a permit granted by local or state governments that prove certain requirements have been met. A roofing certification, on the other hand, usually refers to certificates given by manufacturers (or other organizations) that prove a roofer has knowledge of specific products or procedures.

Industry's Best Guarantees

Peace of mind knowing you obtained your roof at the lowest investment possible.

Not only do you receive a state of the art roof built by highly skilled craftsmen, you also receive peace of mind knowing you obtain your roof at the lowest investment possible. If prior to the installation of your new roof you discover a comparable roof for less money than the one we constructed for your home, we will pay you the difference, plus a bonus. All we ask is the comparison be “apples-to-apples.”

The price you are quoted is the price you will pay, guaranteed.

We DO NOT give estimates! The price you are given is the price that you will pay, guaranteed. If, during the installation of your roof we discover that there is additional work needed to install the roof properly that we didn’t catch during our inspection, we will repair or replace it free of charge. We understand that you budget for a home improvement project based on the numbers given to you by contractors and we believe that those numbers should be honored.

Should a manufacturer refuse to honor their warranty, we accept personal responsibility at NO CHARGE.

When a roof fails that is still under manufacturer's warranty, often the homeowner is caught in the middle of a “Civil War” between the manufacturer and the contractor. The contractor blames the roofing manufacturer’s product for the failure, and the manufacturer blames the contractor for the faulty installation. This standoff often leaves the homeowner out in the rain. Our Presidential Accountability states that should a manufacturer make excuses and refuse to honor their warranty, we will accept personal responsibility and repair your roof at no charge to you for the term of your agreement.

We will make any necessary repairs free for as long as you live in your home.

Your roof will be constructed by certified installers using premium materials. Excluding acts of God, your roof will not falter from normal, everyday exposure. In the unlikely event your roof encounters any workmanship challenges, we will make any necessary repairs absolutely free for as long as you live in your home. You will never roof again.

Not completely satisfied after 365 days? We’ll correct the problem or your money back, guaranteed.

We strive to be the most professional and reliable roofing company on the planet and we are confident in our ability to make you a satisfied customer that we offer the Roof Assurance Guarantee. We will give you 365 days to “test drive” your new roof. If, after the first 365 days you are not completely satisfied with the customer service or the performance of the roof, we will correct the problem. If that still doesn’t make you comfortable with your decision just give us a call and we will remove the roof and then refund 100% of your investment.
